svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The crew phone: start, settle, swap (crew, venue staff)
svg.text: 11 · The crew phone: start, settle, swap (crew, venue staff)
Use case: one crew member runs the finals from the stage with a phone: starts the season, settles a dispute, swaps a player who had to leave

g.text: the team reveal, then the bracket

svg.text: 1 · Start
When the season is full (or the crew
starts it early), one tap draws and starts.
2 · Now
The next act fills the top; groups follow in
play order.

g.text: Tap the report you agree with

svg.text: 3 · Settle
The two reports as cards; the drag order
is one tap away.

g.text: Drag a player onto another. Possible until a team's
Swap Player Four for Player Thirteen

svg.text: 4 · Swap
The legacy's live swap, plus the
substitutes' list from the left-out players

g.text: Two minutes since the group was called.
Ask the teams, or set the code from the

svg.text: 5 · A missing code
The crew may set any match's lobby
code, as the legacy's admin could.
Notes

The crew phone is the organiser shell at phone width, not a separate app; the rights decide what it shows (O5). Pings for a long dispute or a missing code go to the crew who are on duty for the finals (O3).
